Join Our Student Tech Community:

Welcome to an exciting community for students who are passionate about technology, innovation, AI, cloud computing, and building impactful projects!

This community is being created to bring together students of KNS Institute of Technology who want to learn, explore, collaborate, and grow beyond the classroom.

As part of various student-led technology initiatives, including Google Student Ambassador (GSA) and AWS SBCL, our goal is to build a strong student community where members can discover new technologies, participate in exciting activities, and connect with like-minded innovators.

What can you expect?

  • Hands-on sessions on AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning and emerging technologies
  • ️ Learning opportunities in Cloud Computing and AWS
  • Workshops, demos and interactive technical sessions
  • Hackathons, challenges and competitions
  • Networking and collaboration with fellow students
  • Guidance for building projects, portfolios and technical skills
  • Updates about exciting events, programs, internships and opportunities
  • Fun community activities designed to learn and grow together
  • Certificates of participation and exclusive tech goodies 

Whether you're a complete beginner, a curious learner, or already building amazing projects, everyone with an interest in technology is welcome!

Why join?

  • Technology is better when we learn and build together. This community will be a space to ask questions, share ideas, collaborate on projects, discover opportunities, and grow your skills.

Join us and become part of a community of learners, creators and innovators!

Open to students of KNS Institute of Technology
Learn. Build. Connect. Grow.

Register now and be part of the journey!

Join the official WhatsApp Community to receive more updates: https://chat.whatsapp.com/GOu0glryCCP9MQMMwzbYBF
